name: Eurocopter EC120 Colibri
summary: A compact five-seat single-turbine helicopter with a ducted fenestron tail and a rounded egg-shaped nose; used for training, tours and light utility.

wings: Low mast fairing blending into the roof
engines: Single turbine engine with exhaust near the rear of the roof
Smooth dorsal cowl, no tall stack
fuselage: Rounded bulbous egg-shaped nose with a large glazed front
Five seats; front hinged doors and rear passenger doors
tail: Fenestron (ducted fan) set in the vertical fin
Short stabilizer and a tapering boom

tellTales: Ducted tail fan on a small turbine helicopter
Rounded egg-shaped glass nose and compact five-seat cabin
Three-blade rotor with no conventional tail rotor

confusedWith.howToTell: The H125 has an exposed two-blade tail rotor, a taller boxy cabin and a pointed windscreen; the EC120 has a ducted tail fan and a rounder, shorter fuselage.
The Cabri is a tiny two-seat piston helicopter; the EC120 is a larger five-seat turbine with a bigger fenestron.
The H130 has a bigger, wider cabin that seats up to seven, with large windows and a deeper body; the EC120 is smaller and narrower.
The Bell 505 has a two-blade rotor and a conventional tail rotor; the EC120 has a ducted fan and three blades.
